name: Xiaomi X20+ (EU)

radios.note: No Xiaomi page found that names the radio; control is through the Xiaomi Home app.

matter.note: No Matter claim on Xiaomi's pages and no CSA listing surfaced in search.

apple_home.note: No Xiaomi or Apple page found that lists Apple Home or Matter for this model.

google_home.note: Xiaomi's pages list voice control with Google Assistant, with a note that it is not available in every language and country. Spain-page wording not confirmed.

alexa.note: Xiaomi's pages list voice control with Alexa (e.g. start cleaning) and say a compatible Alexa device is needed. Spain-page wording not confirmed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's official Xiaomi Miio page lists a generic Xiaomi Mi Robot Vacuum but no model list, so the X20+ is not confirmed. Community HACS integrations are not counted.

hubRequired.note: Xiaomi's pages describe app control and do not mention a hub; not stated explicitly.

localControl.note: Xiaomi does not say whether any control works without its cloud.

cleaning.note: Spain spec page lists two mop-pad holders with two pads in the box.

navigation.note: Xiaomi's AU page also lists structured-light obstacle avoidance.

suctionPa.note: Figure from Xiaomi's AU overview page; Spain page not checked.

selfEmptying.note: The all-in-one station empties the dust bin; this is the X20+ bundle (the plain X20 has no such base).

summary: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20+ is a vacuum-and-mop robot with LDS laser navigation, 6000 Pa suction and an all-in-one station that empties the dust bin by itself. Xiaomi lists voice control with Alexa and Google Assistant.
caveats: Matter, Apple Home and SmartThings support are not confirmed by Xiaomi.
Voice assistants are not available in every language and country.
